IsTouchingObjSide.name: Is sprite touching a block on its side
summary: Returns: A = [sprite object status] & 3, non-zero if blocked on its left or right. Z flag set accordingly.

IsOnGround.name: Is sprite on the ground
summary: Returns: A = [sprite object status] & 4, non-zero if standing on a block.

IsTouchingCeiling.name: Is sprite touching a ceiling
summary: Returns: A = [sprite object status] & 8, non-zero if bumping a block above.

UpdateYPosNoGrvty.name: Update sprite Y position, no gravity
summary: Long-call wrapper (sets the data bank to $01) for SubSprYPosNoGrvty: Y position += Y speed.
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

UpdateXPosNoGrvty.name: Update sprite X position
summary: Long-call wrapper for SubSprXPosNoGrvty: X position += X speed.
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

UpdateSpritePos.name: Update sprite position with gravity
summary: Long-call wrapper for SubUpdateSprPos: applies speeds and gravity and checks for block contact, setting the sprite object status.
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

SprSprInteract.name: Sprite-to-sprite interaction
summary: Long-call wrapper for SubSprSprInteract (contacts between sprites, e.g. kicked shells hitting enemies).
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

SprSpr+MarioSprRts.name: Sprite and Mario contact check
summary: Long-call wrapper for SubSprSpr+MarioSpr (sprite contact with sprites and with Mario).
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

GenericSprGfxRt0.name: Generic sprite graphics routine
summary: Long-call wrapper for SubSprGfx0Entry0, the generic sprite drawing code.
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

InvertAccum.name: Negate A, skid smoke, run all sprites
summary: Contains several routines that follow each other.
$01804E: spawns a smoke puff under a sprite on the ground (every 4th frame, non-slippery levels, on screen) into a free slot of the four smoke slots at $17C0-$17CF.

$01808C (long call): main sprite loop. Resets per-frame Mario carry/platform/Yoshi flags, then for slots 11..0 sets the OAM index, decrements timers and calls HandleSprite. Clears Mario's Yoshi flags if no Yoshi sprite ran.
$0180D2: sets the OAM index of slot X and decrements its seven timers.

IsSprOffScreen.name: Is sprite off screen
summary: Returns: A = [horizontal off screen flag] OR [vertical off screen flag]; non-zero if off screen.

$0180D2 (following code, same section): sets the OAM index for slot X from the tables at $07:F000/$07:F0B4 and decrements the sprite timers [$1540], [$154C], [$1558], [$1564], [$1FE2], [$15AC], [$163E] if non-zero, unless the slot is empty or sprites are locked.

HandleSprite.name: Run sprite by status
summary: Status 0 erases the sprite, status 8 runs its main routine directly, any other status jumps through SpriteStatusRtPtr.
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

SpriteStatusRtPtr.name: Pointer table: sprite status routines
summary: Indexed by the sprite status in [$14C8,X], 16-bit pointers.

EraseSprite.name: Erase sprite permanently
summary: Sets the sprite's index in the level sprite table to $FF so it is not reloaded when the screen scrolls back. Status stays 0.
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

HandleGoalPowerup.name: Handle goal powerup sprite (status C)
summary: Runs the sprite's main routine, despawns it when off screen, moves it with gravity (reduced by 2 per frame) and sets a Y speed when it lands.

HandleSprLvlEnd.name: Handle sprite at level end (status 6)
summary: Calls LvlEndSprCoins to turn the sprite into a coin.

CallSpriteInit.name: Initialize sprite
summary: Sets the sprite status to 8 (normal) and jumps through SpriteInitPtr by sprite number.
Parameters: X: sprite slot.

SpriteInitPtr.name: Pointer table: sprite init routines
summary: Indexed by sprite number $00-$C8, 16-bit pointers. Each row names the sprite.

InitGreyLavaPlat.name: Init grey platform on lava
summary: Y position += 2.

InitBowserStatue.name: Init Bowser statue
summary: Direction = 1. Picks a variant like an exploding block; sprite state = variant; variant 2 uses palette 1.

InitTimedPlat.name: Init timed lift
summary: [$1570,X] = $3F if X position bit 4 is set, else $FF (initial timer value, probably).

InitYoshiEgg.name: Init Yoshi egg
summary: Palette is chosen from bits 4-5 of the X position. Increments [$187B,X] (probably makes it unstompable).

InitDiagBouncer.name: Init diagonal bouncer
summary: Faces Mario, X speed $10 or $F0 by direction, Y speed $F0 (up). Used by the reflecting Boo stream and reflecting fireball.

InitWoodSpike.name: Init wooden spike
summary: Moves the sprite $40 pixels up from its placed position.

InitWoodSpike2.name: Init wooden spike, up first
summary: Same as InitMontyMole.

InitBowserScene.name: Init Bowser scene trigger
summary: Calls CODE_03A0F1 in bank $03.

InitSumoBrother.name: Init Sumo Brother
summary: Sprite state = 3, [$1540,X] = $70. Also the entry for InitSlidingKoopa ($018379).

InitSlidingKoopa.name: Init sliding Koopa
summary: [$1540,X] = 4 via the store in InitSumoBrother.

InitBanzai.name: Init Banzai Bill
summary: If Mario is to the right of the spawn point the sprite is erased (it only flies left); otherwise plays sound $09 to [$1DFC].

InitBallNChain.name: Init ball and chain
summary: A = $38, stored at $01839C in [$187B,X] (probably chain length).

InitGreyChainPlat.name: Init grey platform on chain
summary: [$187B,X] = $30 (probably chain length). Shared tail for InitBallNChain.

InitExplodingBlk.name: Init exploding block
summary: Sprite state = ExplodingBlkSpr[(X position >> 4) & 3]. Returns: Y = 0-3 variant.

InitScalePlats.name: Init scale platforms
summary: Saves the start Y position ([$1534], [$151C]) and sets state/[$1602] to X position + $80 or $40 (type from X bit 4), probably the partner platform position.

InitMsg+SideExit.name: Init message box and side exit
summary: [$1564,X] = $28 timer (blocks sprite contact).

InitYoshi.name: Init Yoshi
summary: Direction = 1. Erases the sprite if Mario already has Yoshi from the overworld.

s0183EF.name: Data: urchin init speeds
summary: Speed pairs used by InitUrchin: X speed table at $0183EF, Y speed table at $0183F0.

InitSpikeTop.name: Init Spike Top
summary: Sets direction bit from Mario's side, enters InitUrchin at $01841D for speeds, clears [$164A,X].

InitUrchinWallFllw.name: Init wall-following Urchin
summary: Y position += 1, then falls into InitFuzzBall+Spark.

InitFuzzBall+Spark.name: Init Fuzzball and Sparky
summary: Runs InitUrchin, then flips the direction bit in [$151C,X] and sets state = [$151C] >> 2.

InitUrchin.name: Init Urchin
summary: Direction bit [$151C,X] = X position bit 4; speeds from DATA_0183EF/0183F0. Falls into InitRipVanFish.

InitRipVanFish.name: Init Rip Van Fish
summary: [$164A,X]++ (probably the in-water flag).

InitKey+BabyYoshi.name: Init key and baby Yoshi
summary: Sprite status = 9 (carryable).

InitChangingItem.name: Init changing item
summary: Sprite state += 1.

InitPeaBouncer.name: Init pea bouncer
summary: X position -= 8.

InitPSwitch.name: Init P-switch
summary: Type [$151C,X] = (X >> 4) & 1 (blue/silver), palette from PSwitchPal, status 9 (carryable).

PSwitchPal.name: Data: P-switch palettes
summary: $018468 (code after the table): erases the sprite once off screen (jump target for InitLakitu).

InitLakitu.name: Init Lakitu and spawn cloud
summary: If another Lakitu or Lakitu cloud exists the sprite is erased. Otherwise clears respawn state, saves its Y position in [$18C3], spawns a Lakitu cloud ($87) in a free slot at its position and falls into InitMontyMole.

InitMontyMole.name: Init Monty Mole
summary: [$151C,X] = X position bit 4 (variant flag).

InitCreateEatBlk.name: Init creating/eating block
summary: [$1909] = $FF, then InitMontyMole.

InitBulletBill.name: Init Bullet Bill
summary: Sprite state = side Mario is on, [$1540,X] = $10.

InitClappinChuck.name: Init Clappin' Chuck
summary: Chuck type 8.

InitPitchinChuck.name: Init Pitchin' Chuck
summary: [$187B,X] = (X position & $30) >> 4; chuck type $0A.

InitPuntinChuck.name: Init Puntin' Chuck
summary: Chuck type 9.

InitWhistlinChuck.name: Init Whistlin' Chuck
summary: Chuck type $0B.

InitChuck.name: Init Splittin'/Bouncin' Chuck
summary: Chuck type 5.

InitDigginChuck.name: Init Diggin' Chuck and set chuck type
summary: $018508: [$1540,X] = $30, direction from X bit 4, type 4.
$01851A (shared by all chucks): sprite state = chuck type, faces Mario, [$151C,X] = DATA_018526[Y].
Parameters: A: chuck type (for entry $01851A).

InitSuperKoopa.name: Init Super Koopa
summary: Y speed = $28, then FaceMario.

InitSuperKoopaFthr.name: Init feather Super Koopa
summary: Faces Mario. If X bit 4 is set sets sprite tweaker bytes 1656, 1662, 1686; otherwise [$1534,X] += 1.

InitPokey.name: Init Pokey
summary: State = segment bit mask: $1F (5 segments) on Yoshi, $07 (3) otherwise. Then FaceMario.

InitDinos.name: Init Dino Rhino and Torch
summary: [$151C,X] = 4, falls into InitBomb.

InitBomb.name: Init Bob-omb
summary: [$1540,X] = $FF fuse timer, then FaceMario.

InitBubbleSpr.name: Init bubble with sprite
summary: Variant from InitExplodingBlk stored in state, [$1534,X] -= 1, FaceMario.

InitGrnBounceKoopa.name: Init green bouncing Koopa
summary: [$160E,X] = Y position bit 4, falls into InitStandardSprite.

InitStandardSprite.name: Init standard sprite
summary: [$1570,X] = random number, falls into FaceMario.

FaceMario.name: Face Mario
summary: Sprite direction = side Mario is on (0 = Mario to the right).
Parameters: X: sprite slot.
Returns: Y = direction.

InitBowsersFire.name: Init Bowser's fireball
summary: Plays sound $17, then FaceMario.

InitPowerUp.name: Init powerup
summary: Sprite state += 1.

InitFishbone.name: Init Fishbone
summary: [$1540,X] = random number & $1F, then FaceMario.

InitDownPiranha.name: Init upside-down Piranha Plant
summary: Sets bit 7 of the palette byte (vertical flip) and moves the sprite up $10 pixels.
